# autocomplete

> Fast tab completion for bash (down to the stock macOS bash 3.2) and zsh, written in C. A lightweight alternative to bash-completion: no Homebrew bash, no bash-completion package, no shell scripts. zsh init: `eval "$(autocomplete zsh)"`. Bundled completions for docker, git, kubectl, make, mvn, npm and killall; new commands are added with small YAML spec files.

Key facts:

- Registered with `complete -o nospace -C 'autocomplete _complete'`; every TAB runs the C binary directly. Shell startup loads nothing else.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://github.com/hza/autocomplete/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` (or `wget -qO- … | sh`), then open a new terminal. Init line: `eval "$(autocomplete bash)"`.
- In bash 3.2, `source <(autocomplete bash)` silently does nothing; use `eval "$(autocomplete bash)"`.
- Specs are YAML files named after the command, looked up in `$AUTOCOMPLETE_SPECS`, `~/.config/autocomplete`, then the bundled specs directory.
- License: MIT.
